in_sanskrit.name: Jantu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little, Young
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jantu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Jantu is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a diminutive form of the word 'Jaata' which means 'born'. It is a name for a young child, symbolizing new beginnings and fresh starts.

in_tamil.name: ஜாந்து
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who knows or has knowledge

in_telugu.long_meaning: One who has knowledge or wisdom
